scope: Two network namespaces on the same workstation. Shared physical CPU/GPU resources. No Jetson measurements.
timing_scope: Original image retrieval and raw-payload preparation excluded. Local phase includes preprocessing, reset where applicable, inference, and prediction extraction. Remote RPC includes connection establishment, transport, server execution, and response.
limitations: Smoke test, not a final repeated benchmark.
Static OpenFlow forwarding; no Ryu association or QoS queues.
